Run Sensitivity Analysis for Specified Scenarios

runSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios.Rd

This function executes sensitivity analysis for the specified scenarios in the project configuration. It checks for the presence of the sensitivity file, derives the PK parameters and output paths configured for each scenario, and runs the enhanced sensitivity workflow, saving the results to CSV files.

Usage

runSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios(
  projectConfiguration,
  scenarioList,
  scenarioNames = NULL,
  sensitivitysheet,
  referenceScenario = NULL,
  variationRange = 0.1,
  numberOfSteps = 2,
  simulationRunOptions = ospsuite::SimulationRunOptions$new(showProgress = TRUE),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

projectConfiguration

An object representing the project configuration.

scenarioList

A list of scenarios to analyze.

scenarioNames

A vector of scenario names to run the analysis on. Defaults to NULL.

sensitivitysheet

The name of the sheet in the sensitivity Excel file to use for analysis.

referenceScenario

Optional scenario name used as the denominator for ratio mode. When provided, sensitivities are computed as `scenario / referenceScenario`.

variationRange

Numeric fraction defining how much each sensitivity parameter is varied around baseline (e.g., `0.1` means +/- 10%).

numberOfSteps

Integer number of perturbation steps on each side of baseline used for sensitivity estimation.

simulationRunOptions

Optional `SimulationRunOptions` passed to the simulation runs.

overwrite

A logical indicating whether to overwrite existing results. Defaults to TRUE.

Details

Repeated rows in the sensitivity sheet that share the same `parameter` value are treated as one grouped sensitivity label, so multiple `parameterPath` values can be varied together.

Ratio mode is only applied when `referenceScenario` is provided. In that case the sensitivity is calculated for `scenario / referenceScenario`.

Runs sensitivity analysis for each selected scenario and optionally computes scenario/reference ratios when `referenceScenario` is provided.

See also

Other sensitivity analysis: addSensitivityTable(), runRepresentativeSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios()
